notes.title: v1.41: Small Update
notes.notes:
Just a small update to address a few issues:
 - Fixed missing model faces on CVN-78.
 - Fixed missing reflection map in Park.
 - Bow steering thrusters now toggle based on forward velocity instead of throttle.
 - Oculus Quest 2 controllers via Link no longer display misaligned texture.
 - Increased rock arch so Victory can sail beneath.
 - Adjusted bikini buoyancy. ;)

notes.title: Small Update v1.01
notes.notes:
Just a small update to fix a couple of niggles:
[list]
[*]Fixed particle sizes not always scaling correctly when toggling ship scale.
[*]Fixed an audio bug, where if you went below the ocean and resurfaced the volume didn't adjust correctly.
[*]Increased controller smoothing when holding a ship.
[*]Underwater particles are back.
[*]
[/list]
